reviews.text: Kind, friendly, and highly professional. Unfortunately, my cat suffered a serious illness, and I had to visit them for more than just a checkup. I have nothing but words of gratitude for Lurdes, Gracia, and the entire team. They gave us the best possible treatment from the very first moment, both professionally and personally. I don't know of any other clinic better for taking my cats.

It's been just over two months since we had to say goodbye to our cat, Murphy. Despite the sadness of his illness, we want to express our deepest gratitude to the veterinarians who cared for him, especially Gracia and Lurdes. They were incredibly kind and professional throughout the entire process, and we felt very supported until the very end. We will always be grateful for all the care he received.

We took my little bird there and they treated us wonderfully. Dr. Oriana is incredibly kind, friendly, and gentle. She treated our bird with great care and dedication. I definitely recommend this veterinary clinic.
My dog ​​was neutered three years ago because they didn't do a pathology report, with consequences for my dog... it has changed our lives for the worse for both of us.
Hi Esther, thank you so much for your 5 stars ❤️
Excellent service. They performed a procedure on my dog ​​and everything went very well.

I want to highlight the excellent care at this veterinary center, especially the careful and professional treatment they give to cats. From the very first moment, it's clear they understand their needs and know how to handle them with patience, respect, and lots of love—something that's not easy to find these days.

Both the veterinarians and the reception staff are kind, approachable, and very attentive. They always convey a sense of calm and genuinely care about the well-being of the animals and their owners.

For those of us who have cats, finding a center that provides such specialized and sensitive care makes a huge difference. It's so appreciated to have professionals who understand feline behavior and make each visit much less stressful. Without a doubt, a highly recommended place.
They know and love animals.

I'm a veterinarian, and I took in a litter of stray kittens. The smallest and sickest is now my cat, Milo, and we will always be grateful to Lurdes and the entire team at Vetnatura for saving his life. It was a very complex case, with many seizures, no effective treatment, and countless tests without a diagnosis. We even sought second opinions at specialist clinics. Milo's chances were dwindling, and we were left with the difficult decision of euthanasia. I remembered hearing great things about a feline specialist in Valencia, so we traveled there from a small town in Teruel. Today, I can attest to what a spectacular professional and person Lurdes is. She provided the diagnostic clarity I couldn't find anywhere else and a real solution from the very first moment. Thank you so much from the bottom of my heart.

Three dental surgeries on three different cats, all poorly performed and with long-term consequences for the felines, confirmed by current veterinarians. At least €1500 was spent, and they gave me one less dose of the antibiotic than I needed. I went to get the missing dose, and after all I'd already spent, they tried to charge me for it. To top it off, the woman at the counter confronted me, thinking I was trying to scam them. Shameful.

-Response to your response: Of course, I dedicate myself to criticizing random veterinary clinics because there's a worldwide conspiracy against your clinic and I'm bored 😉 Obviously, my name isn't BEATRIX KIDDOX. I've had terrible experiences with the clinic you mentioned, and now, two years after the procedure, with yours, when various veterinarians have been shocked by my cats' mouths and have asked me in amazement who performed the surgery. Furthermore, I've noticed that whenever someone criticizes your work, you try to deflect blame and deny any contact with that person. People can do what they think is best, but failing in 3 out of 3 surgeries is very concerning, as is the subsequent behavior. I'm leaving my experience here, and everyone can make their own decisions. And I find it deplorable that you say I've published the same review for other clinics when that's completely untrue. Fortunately, people can verify this by looking at my reviews and seeing how far you're willing to go.

I have no words to thank Lurdes and her entire team.

In such a difficult time as this, they are being an enormous support. It's so clear that they love cats and know exactly what they're doing. They explain everything with care, they listen, and they truly make you feel supported.

Amidst how tough everything is, it gives me so much peace to know that my kitten is in the best hands.

I wish I had found them sooner. They are wonderful 💛
A meow-meow from Brisa 🐾
Great professionals
Thanks a lot !!!!

Not recommended for serious conditions; don't send your pets there. I speak from experience: if your animal has cancer, they'll give you the runaround, you'll spend a lot of money, and your companion will die. If you see they can't determine the cause of the illness, go to a veterinary hospital and don't wait days.

Without a doubt, a friendly and completely trustworthy veterinary clinic. Many years of experience and exceptional service from all the staff.
Thank you, Lourdes, for always being there when we needed you and for going out of your way to care for our animals. Bongo especially appreciates it!

Excellent service and care for my cats. They have extensive experience and work with ample resources, coordinating with the leading veterinary hospitals in Valencia for the most delicate cases. A 10 out of 10 for the entire Vetnature team!

They are the best, without a doubt!!!! 😍😍😍 They love animals and always show it with their unconditional affection on every visit. They are also incredibly professional and stay up-to-date on all kinds of diseases. I'm currently taking my third cat, who tested positive for feline leukemia and has kidney cancer, and thanks to them, she's having an amazing quality of life!! So I know what I'm talking about. Thank you so much, ladies, for the wonderful work you do!!! ❤️❤️❤️❤️

Lourdes and her team are wonderful. I've been to many veterinary clinics, many of which I'm very happy and grateful for, but I've never seen anything like this in feline medicine, both in terms of knowledge and the wonderful way they treat cats, even though my cat is quite difficult. Congratulations and thank you ❤️

I went in with a very weak baby turtledove I found on Three Kings' Day, and two weeks later it's already flying free. You rarely feel comfortable at the vet, but here? It's wonderful. You can tell they often treat all kinds of animals, and with passion.

On the 23rd, I called to schedule an appointment for my dog ​​because he was vomiting and had diarrhea (gastroenteritis). The person who answered told me they didn't have an appointment available. When I asked what I should do, her response was, "Take him to another clinic you have further in Valencia." I hope she never experiences anything like this, and her manner was quite inappropriate. My dog ​​certainly won't be returning to that clinic (friends I've told agree) because their professionalism left much to be desired. At least at the other clinic I took him to, they told me to come in as soon as I explained his condition, but that I would have to wait. The treatment I received that day and during the follow-up in the following days was impeccably professional. I hope this clinic takes a good look at how their staff responds and, above all, how they treat animals.

I'm replying this way because she won't let me respond. That wasn't her actual answer, as she claimed that what she didn't do was... There were enough people because they were on vacation for those days, and I still maintain that the way things were handled wasn't the most appropriate. Anyway, if you want to avoid bad reviews and save face, don't do it. Thank you.
Fantastic! Professional and caring service. Very happy and I recommend it 100%.

Yesterday, we accompanied a very elderly person whose dog had been hit by a car. We arrived at 7:55 pm (they close at 8 pm) to see if they could examine her. They closed the clinic and stayed with the owner and the dog. At 9:30 pm, they contacted me to let me know how the dog and her owner were doing and notified a family member to come and pick them up. They truly demonstrated tremendous humanity, empathy, and professionalism. THANK YOU!!!!
Very competent and friendly. My pet loves going.
Excellent service!! Thank you so much for your work!

We visited the vet today for the first time with our kitten Salem, desperate because of a skin problem after trying unsuccessful treatments. Raquel treated us—she was fantastic! From the way she treated our cat to how she treated us, to the explanations she gave us and the care she showed. Definitely highly recommended.
My foster cat (pre-adoption) had surgery and it was great, everything went very well.
Very pleasant and professional.

Excellent veterinary center. My senior cat arrived in Spain with a bladder problem, and Lourdes and the entire team helped us through the crisis and referred us to an excellent hospital for surgery. Thanks to that, Tulio had two more years of good quality life. My other cat, Lili, is in perfect health, and although she doesn't like going to see Lourdes, her annual checkups are always very calm thanks to the separate areas for cats and the low-stress environment the center maintains. Definitely recommended.
The vet is great! Polite staff, caring attitude, separate dogs and cats to keep the animals calm. Quick and punctual service. Reasonable prices.
We couldn't be happier with the service we received! A million thanks for taking such good care of our kitty. Bego is wonderful 😻 …
